summary: Full frontend E2E of The Vault feature. Verified: (a) Units page — CVF shows 101 plots, VV shows 256 plots. (b) VV Book dialog has NO vault-section; CVF Book dialog HAS vault-section. (c) Toggling vault-toggle reveals vault-variant, vault-total, and prefilled vault schedule (10x10%) with vault-sched-total matching vault-total (no vault-gap). (d) Breaking one Vault instalment surfaces vault-gap and blocks s-submit (toast shown, modal stays open). (e) Re-picking the variant regenerates a matching schedule; Confirm sale (s-submit) then books successfully — DB now has 1 land + 10 vault payments and unit.vault.enabled=true. (f) Sales drilldown for the plot shows both 'Land · plot payment schedule' and 'The Vault · construction schedule' sections and BOTH edit buttons (edit-schedule-<uid>, edit-vault-schedule-<uid>). (g) After breaking a vault instalment amount in DB, the Sales page mismatched-plots table shows a row with data-testid `mismatch-101-vault` and stream label 'THE VAULT'; edit-plan-101-vault opens the ScheduleEditor titled 'Edit Vault payment plan · Plot 101' (schedule-save disabled while gap>0). (h) Admin dashboard shows revenue-by-stream with stream-land + stream-vault columns and vault-attach '1 plot(s) with The Vault'; CVF project card has dash-streams-<CVF>, VV project card has NO dash-streams-<VV>. DB restored: CVF 101 available (vault_config intact), VV 256 untouched, zero payments/revisions on CVF.

Sales.jsx still ~950 lines; drilldown, cancellations, revisions, mismatch all live here — consider splitting for maintainability (pre-existing).
